checkedAlternates.risk: Plasma makes up ~55% of whole blood volume.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Blood plasma is the acellular liquid matrix (group-1), whereas erythrocytes and platelets are cellular/fragment formed elements (group-2).

checkedAlternates.risk: Monocytes are phagocytic innate immune cells like neutrophils.
checkedAlternates.resolution: Monocytes lack prominent cytoplasmic granules and are classified as agranulocytes (group-4), unlike the three granulocytes (group-3).
